newsitem.title: USA: Wendy's to buy 37 Rax restaurants.
newsitem.headline: Wendy's to buy 37 Rax restaurants.

text.p: Wendy's International said Friday it has agreed to buy 37 Rax restaurants for an undisclosed amount of cash.
The transaction was expected to be completed by the end of January, the restaurant company said.

At least 30 of the restaurants, mostly located in central Ohio and West Virginia, would be converted to Tim Hortons fresh baked goods restaurants, Wendy's said. The remaining seven would become Wendy's restaurants.

"With five Tim Hortons already in development in central Ohio, this acquisition will enable the rapid expansion of Canada's largest coffee and fresh baked goods chain, said Gordon Teter, Wendy's president and chief executive.
Wendy's stock was unchanged at $22.125 on the New York Stock Exchange in late trading.
